none: PAS BM-E2D6CE: BM-E2D6CE: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the second or third century AD. The sealing is rectangular in shape and in section. The upper surface of the sealing is stamped with a rectangular die and the legend 'LE palmG.'. On the underside of the sealing, a further legend reading 'MCS7' is also visible which can be read as 'leg(io) M(arcus) C(...) S(...) (centurio)' The sealing is pierced horizontally,…
